title: COD that is not the default can be made the default
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop uses Due on Receipt as the default, and at least one customer is on COD.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Due on Receipt is the shop's default for new customers.
  • At least one customer holds COD.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "COD" row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu shows exactly these items, in this order: "Make Default for New Customers" (circle check), "Move Customers" (person). Nothing else shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-R1: “Each row's "⋯" menu shows only the items that apply to that term, in this order. An item that applies but is blocked shows greyed out and does nothing when clicked; hovering it shows the reason.”
  • S2-R1 table, Make Default row: “"Make Default for New Customers" (circle check) | Active terms that are not the default and not Credit Hold | Never”
  • S2-N1: “Standard terms never show "Edit" or "Delete Credit Term".”
  • S2-N2: “COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold never show "Deactivate" (S1-R9 explains why on the lock icon).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "2 Move customers to another term" ("Without the customer permissions"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p2-09-without-the-customer-permissions.png

The design's own words:

  • “A user with Settings → Finance but without Customers → Create & Edit or View and Manage AP/AR Data sees Move Customers greyed in every row menu, with the hover text "You need Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data to move customers." (S4-N1). They can still make a default.”
